description: Locked factorial ablation matrix for the roman_features/ isolated experiment system. All runs share the EXP-PROP-001 model configuration (learned deviation, mlp comparator, deepset pooling), the official 4-fold protocol, and seed 2026. HP block is a verbatim copy of src/registry.py PROPOSAL_HP (2026-09-23).

hyperparameters.seeds: locked src/registry.SEEDS (10 seeds: 1234, 100, 0, 2024, 42, 3, 123, 13, 64, 2026) — same seeds as the original suite

k_index.reference_scope: per-subject, all valid fixation->saccade pairs across the full session (no diagnosis labels)

runs.role: Direction-frequency features (20-degree bins, 18 features) added to base45.
runs.hypothesis: Relative direction frequencies carry SZ/HC signal not present in the 45 base features; AUC improves over A0.

runs.role: Ambient/focal K-index (att_k_mean, 1 feature) added to base45.
runs.hypothesis: The subject-standardized ambient/focal K-index carries SZ/HC signal not present in the 45 base features; AUC improves over A0.

runs.role: Both feature groups added; tests the combined contribution and possible interaction.
runs.hypothesis: Direction frequencies and K-index are complementary; combined gain exceeds each individual gain (A3-A0 > max(A1-A0, A2-A0)).

runs.role: Sensitivity: 10-degree direction bins (36 features) instead of 20-degree bins.
runs.hypothesis: Finer angular resolution matters only if directional signal exists; A4-A1 close to 0 supports 20-degree sufficiency.

runs.role: Optional: 10-degree bins + K-index. Supported but not part of the required experiment matrix.
runs.hypothesis: Not part of the primary factorial; run on demand only.
